lines.text: Eliphaz the Temanite says Job once steadied those who stumbled, but now trouble has come and Job is dismayed.
Eliphaz asks whether the innocent ever perish, and says the wicked perish by the breath of God like broken lions.
Eliphaz says a word came in a daytime vision, and a spirit asked if a mortal can be more righteous than God.

wrong_details.true: visions in the night, when deep sleep falls on men

lines.text: Eliphaz says resentment kills a fool, and that if he were Job, he would take his case to the elders.

wrong_details.wrong: take his case to the elders
wrong_details.true: appeal to God and lay his cause before Him

lines.text: Eliphaz says the man whom God corrects is blessed, because God wounds but also binds and heals.
